Desktop.dc.html.title: Grow light on a PC screen

n_main.text: Grow light card. Tap the door switch to try it: the plug goes off at once and comes back on when the door closes, but only inside the on hours. Unbuilt: nothing, this card is the built entity set.

n_setup.text: Add grow light setup step. Pick the plug, the start time, how many hours per day, and any door or window sensors. The same fields are in Options so they can be changed later.

n_desktop.text: PC screen: the same grow light with room to spread out. Status tiles, a 24-hour bar with the paused stretch in amber, a recent changes list, and the settings beside it. Below about 900 px the settings drop under the main column. Try the door button. Unbuilt: the Light today total and the recent changes list (they need history reading, not yet in the helper).

n_picker.text: Crop picker: the Crop field searches all 68 vegetables and legumes. Each row has a photo of the plant, its group, day-length type, days to the end and the photo credit. Type to filter, tap to pick. Unbuilt: nothing, this is the built select with photos.

n_card.text: Crop card: switch between the seven crops grown at home and drag the day slider. The stage, light hours and watering interval follow the real catalogue. Press Watered to count the next watering from today. Built as the Grow light card (grow-light-card) in the card picker; not yet seen in a browser.

n_crops.text: PC screen: every crop grown at home side by side, with photo, stage bar, light hours and watering interval. Drag the days slider to see them move through their stages. Built as the Grow light overview card (grow-light-overview-card); not yet seen in a browser.

n_alerts.text: Alerts and costs: drag the day to see which alerts the seven home crops send that morning (stage changes, harvest, watering due, sow the next batch for radish, lettuce and mung bean). Drag the soil reading below 30% to see dry soil water at once, and the light power to see energy and cost. Price is a sample. Unbuilt: nothing in the helper; the phone notifications themselves are the notify action's own.
